import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAXN = 410;
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static int n, t;
    static String[] g, h;
    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] dis = new int[12][12];

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> graph = new ArrayList<>();

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), c));
        graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel(int s, int t, int[] level) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph.get(u)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int u, int t, int pushed, int[] level, int[] ptr) {
        if (u == t) return pushed;
        for (int cid = ptr[u]; cid < graph.get(u).size(); ++cid) {
            Edge e = graph.get(u).get(cid);
            if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.cap > 0) {
                int tr = sendFlow(e.to, t, Math.min(pushed, e.cap), level, ptr);
                if (tr > 0) {
                    e.cap -= tr;
                    graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += tr;
                    return tr;
                }
            }
            ptr[u] = cid + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        int[] level = new int[MAXN];
        while (bfsLevel(s, t, level)) {
            int[] ptr = new int[MAXN];
            while (true) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(s, t, INF, level, ptr);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void bfs1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(tim[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        tim[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int code = q.poll();
            int x = code / 10, y = code % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && g[nx].charAt(ny) >= '0' && g[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9' && tim[nx][ny] > tim[x][y] + 1) {
                    tim[nx][ny] = tim[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(sx * 10 + sy);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int code = q.poll();
            int x = code / 10, y = code % 10;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && h[nx].charAt(ny) >= '0' && h[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9' && dis[nx][ny] > dis[x][y] + 1) {
                    if (tim[nx][ny] >= dis[x][y] + 1) {
                        dis[nx][ny] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                        if (tim[nx][ny] > dis[nx][ny])
                            q.add(nx * 10 + ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        g = new String[n];
        h = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) g[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) h[i] = sc.nextLine();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (g[i].charAt(j) == 'Z')
                    bfs1(i, j);

        int S = 0, T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; ++i) graph.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char cg = g[i].charAt(j);
                if (cg > '0' && cg <= '9')
                    addEdge(S, i * n + j + 1, cg - '0');
                char ch = h[i].charAt(j);
                if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + i * n + j + 1, T, ch - '0');
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char cg = g[i].charAt(j);
                if (cg > '0' && cg <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                            char ch = h[x].charAt(y);
                            if (ch > '0' && ch <= '9' && dis[x][y] <= t)
                                addEdge(i * n + j + 1, n * n + x * n + y + 1, INF);
                        }
                }
            }

        System.out.println(maxFlow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
